contract: Original XMS dispatch table and unsupported-service result remain in source; adapter-bop carries mechanics only.
Original AX/BL success/failure behavior is retained; only adapter-softpc can request typed Bochs A20 mechanics.
Original suballocator/provider algorithms require bounded guest range transactions, not host-address exposure.
Original UMB list and B0/B1/B2 result flow are retained only after a durable bounded guest-byte UMB seam exists.
Original INT 15 notification/query remains source-owned; IVT/interrupt mechanics are a machine seam, not an XMS-local emulation.
Original suballoc API remains a support-package prerequisite; no new allocator is embedded in the XMS mirror.

Historical ULONG-to-host-pointer and NT virtual-memory paths cannot be exposed in a portable x86/x64 profile; preserve originals as evidence and use only a separately proved same-shaped guest-range seam.
Session owns instance state while original XMS globals/data layout and initialization sequence remain source-owned.
